title: Realtor.ca Property Scraper
description: Extract property listings from Realtor.ca. Provide a Realtor.ca map URL or use keyword and location filters.

startUrl.title: Realtor.ca URL
startUrl.description: A Realtor.ca map/search URL. Used when no keyword or location is provided.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Optional keyword filter such as condo, waterfront, garage, or an MLS number. Takes precedence over the Realtor.ca URL when provided.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional city shortcut. Supported examples: Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal, Calgary, Ottawa, Edmonton. Takes precedence over the Realtor.ca URL when provided.

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of property listings to save.

max_pages.title: Max pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of result pages to request.

records_per_page.title: Records per page
records_per_page.description: Listings requested per page, up to 100. Lower values collect more pages, higher values reduce the number of requests.

include_details.title: Include full property details
include_details.description: Fetch the full property record for each listing to collect the complete image gallery and additional building details such as features, architectural style, basement type, and construction year. Disable it for faster runs with smaller records.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxies are recommended for Realtor.ca.
